situations.title: 저산소성 호흡부전 초기 사정
situations.tagline: I can't catch my breath and my chest feels so tight.
situations.brief: 산소요법 단계를 판단하기 위해 저산소성 호흡부전을 초기 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm putting oxygen on you and checking your levels right now.
I need you to take slow breaths with me while I assess you.
Your oxygen is a bit low, so we're going to support your breathing.

situations.title: HFNC 설정·적용
situations.tagline: This machine blowing on my face feels so strong — do I really need all that air?
situations.brief: flow, FiO2, 습화를 설정하며 HFNC를 적용하고 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The high-flow gives you warm, humidified oxygen to make breathing easier.
I've set the flow and oxygen level to match what your body needs.
It feels strong at first, but it's helping you breathe with less effort.

situations.title: NIV 마스크 착용·핏
situations.tagline: This mask is so tight on my face — can you loosen it a little?
situations.brief: 누출과 피부 보호를 고려하며 NIV 마스크를 착용하고 핏을 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll adjust the straps so it seals without pressing too hard.
A good fit stops air from leaking around the edges.
I'll add padding to protect the bridge of your nose.
goals: NIV 마스크 누출을 최소화하는 핏을 맞춘다

situations.title: 산소전달장치 단계 이해
situations.tagline: Why did you switch me from the little nose tubes to this bigger mask?
situations.brief: 비강캐뉼라부터 비재호흡까지 산소전달장치 단계를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The nasal cannula gives a little oxygen, and this mask gives more.
We step up the device as your oxygen needs increase.
This non-rebreather mask delivers the highest oxygen without a machine.

situations.title: 호흡노력·보조근 사용 관찰
situations.tagline: You keep watching my neck and shoulders when I breathe — is something wrong?
situations.brief: 피로 징후를 인지하기 위해 호흡노력과 보조근 사용을 관찰하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm watching how hard you're working to breathe.
Using your neck muscles tells me breathing is taking a lot of effort.
If you start to tire out, we'll give you more support.

situations.title: ABG 채혈·기초 해석
situations.tagline: What does that blood test from my wrist actually tell you?
situations.brief: 산소화와 환기를 구분하며 ABG를 채혈하고 기초 해석하세요.
keyPhrases: This blood gas shows how much oxygen and carbon dioxide are in your blood.
It tells me if your lungs are moving air well enough.
The result helps us fine-tune your oxygen support.

situations.title: HFNC ROX index 반응 평가
situations.tagline: Can you calculate his ROX index — I want to know if the high-flow is really working.
situations.brief: ROX index로 HFNC 실패를 예측하고 반응을 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: His ROX index combines oxygenation and respiratory rate.
A rising ROX suggests the high-flow is succeeding.
A low or falling value warns me he may need escalation.

situations.title: NIV 적응증·금기 판단
situations.tagline: He's confused and has a lot of secretions — is he even a good candidate for the mask?
situations.brief: 의식과 분비물을 고려해 NIV 적응증과 금기를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: NIV needs an alert patient who can protect their airway.
Heavy secretions and confusion make him a poor candidate.
If he can't cooperate, we should consider intubation instead.

situations.title: 고탄산 호흡부전 BiPAP
situations.tagline: My breathing's been terrible with my COPD — is this mask going to help me?
situations.brief: COPD 급성악화의 고탄산 호흡부전에 BiPAP을 적용하고 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: This BiPAP helps you blow off the carbon dioxide that's built up.
It supports each breath so your lungs don't have to work so hard.
As your breathing improves, we'll ease the settings down.

situations.title: 심인성 폐부종 CPAP
situations.tagline: I feel like I'm drowning — I can't get enough air.
situations.brief: 전부하 감소를 목표로 심인성 폐부종에 CPAP을 적용하세요.
keyPhrases: This CPAP pushes the fluid out of your air sacs so you can breathe.
It also eases the strain on your heart.
Try to breathe with the machine; you'll feel relief soon.

situations.title: NIV 부조화·불내성 관리
situations.tagline: I hate this thing, it's fighting me — I can't breathe with it on!
situations.brief: 세팅과 진정 조정을 통해 NIV 부조화와 불내성을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's adjust the settings so the machine follows your breathing.
I'll coach you to relax and breathe with it, not against it.
A little medication can help you tolerate the mask better.

situations.title: NIV 중 흡인 위험 관리
situations.tagline: His stomach's getting distended on the mask and he looks nauseous — could he vomit?
situations.brief: 위팽만과 구토를 고려해 NIV 중 흡인 위험을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Air can push into his stomach and increase his aspiration risk.
Let's keep the head up and consider a gastric tube to decompress.
If he vomits, we remove the mask and clear his airway fast.
goals: NIV 중 위팽만과 흡인 위험을 감시한다

situations.title: NIV에서 삽관 전환 판단
situations.tagline: He's been on the mask an hour and he's not improving — is it time to intubate?
situations.brief: 실패 지표를 보고하며 NIV에서 삽관 전환을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: His gas isn't improving and his work of breathing is rising.
These are signs of NIV failure, so we shouldn't delay intubation.
I'll report the failure indicators to the physician now.

situations.title: 면역저하 환자 NIV 선택
situations.tagline: He's immunocompromised — I heard NIV might be safer than intubating him, is that right?
situations.brief: 감염과 전략을 고려해 면역저하 환자의 NIV 선택을 논의하세요.
keyPhrases: For immunocompromised patients, NIV can avoid ventilator infections.
Early NIV may reduce his risk compared to intubation.
We'll watch him closely so we don't miss the window for escalation.

situations.title: 산소 목표 개별화
situations.tagline: His oxygen is at 100 — isn't more oxygen always better for him?
situations.brief: 과산소를 회피하며 환자별 산소 목표를 개별화하세요.
keyPhrases: More oxygen isn't always better; too much can cause harm.
Let's target a saturation range rather than always maxing it out.
For him, a saturation of 92 to 96 is our goal.

situations.title: HFNC·NIV 중 급성 악화
situations.tagline: He was stable on the high-flow and now he's crashing — reassess him with me, quick!
situations.brief: 즉시 재평가와 에스컬레이션으로 HFNC와 NIV 중 급성 악화에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's reassess his airway, breathing, and oxygen right now.
Turn the FiO2 up and call the physician immediately.
If he doesn't respond, we prepare for intubation without delay.
goals: 비침습 지지 중 급성 악화를 즉시 재평가한다

situations.title: NIV 지연 호흡정지 임박
situations.tagline: We waited too long on the mask — he's barely breathing now, get the airway kit!
situations.brief: NIV 지연으로 호흡정지가 임박한 상황에서 응급 삽관을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: He's about to arrest — start bag-mask ventilation now.
Call the code and get the intubation cart to the bedside.
We should have escalated sooner; let's secure the airway immediately.
goals: NIV 지연에 따른 호흡정지 임박을 인지한다

situations.title: 심한 고탄산 의식저하 위기
situations.tagline: He's barely responding and his CO2 is sky-high — this is CO2 narcosis, isn't it?
situations.brief: CO2 마취와 기도확보를 통해 심한 고탄산 의식저하 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: His depressed consciousness is from severe carbon dioxide narcosis.
He can no longer protect his airway, so we prepare to intubate.
Support his ventilation now while we set up for the tube.
goals: 심한 고탄산에 의한 CO2 마취를 인지한다

situations.title: 마스크 불내성 극심 저산소
situations.tagline: He keeps ripping the mask off and his sats are in the 70s — we can't keep him oxygenated!
situations.brief: 진정과 삽관 결정을 통해 마스크 불내성과 극심한 저산소에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: He can't tolerate the mask and his oxygen is dangerously low.
Non-invasive support is failing, so we move to intubation.
Let's prepare sedation and secure his airway now.

situations.title: 대량 각혈 동반 호흡부전
situations.tagline: He's coughing up a lot of blood and can't breathe — help me turn him and protect his airway!
situations.brief: 기도보호와 측와위를 통해 대량 각혈 동반 호흡부전에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Position him with the bleeding lung down to protect the good lung.
Suction aggressively and give high-flow oxygen.
Call for emergent airway control and notify the physician now.
goals: 대량 각혈 시 기도보호를 최우선으로 시행한다

situations.title: 완화 목적 호흡곤란 관리
situations.tagline: He said he doesn't want a breathing tube — I just want him to be comfortable now.
situations.brief: DNI 환자의 목표를 소통하며 완화 목적으로 호흡곤란을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll honor his wish and focus on keeping him comfortable.
We can ease his breathlessness with gentle oxygen and medication.
Our goal now is his comfort, not more invasive treatment.
goals: DNI 환자의 완화 목표를 가족과 소통한다
